change: sweep products, collections and blogs too, and repair the 9 links that can be proved (round 2)

checks.name: four sections, two provable rules, and an unchecked link is never called broken
the preflight, with a blank cell treated as an erase in every column
THE ONE THAT WOULD CALL LIVE ARTICLES BROKEN: one path segment, not more
checks.expect_failure: a blog ARTICLE link is unchecked, not dead
checks._why: The first four-section run reported about 50 live blog articles as dead, because /blogs/<blog>/<article> was matched as one handle and checked against the blog names. This program has the article list for one blog of seven. A link it cannot check must be counted unchecked, never broken.

checks.name: a repair never moves a link between sections
checks.expect_failure: a live product link is left alone

checks.name: THE ONE THAT WOULD WRITE A LINK TO NOTHING: rule one's liveness requirement
checks.expect_failure: a cleaned handle that is not live is REPORTED, not repaired

checks.name: a map entry whose own target has gone away must fail loudly
checks.expect_failure: a map entry pointing at a page that is no longer live is REPORTED

checks.name: the round trip is what stops an edit outside a href going unnoticed
checks.find: return { roundTrip: undone === before, lengthOk: before.length - after.length === removed, removed };
checks.replace: return { roundTrip: true, lengthOk: before.length - after.length === removed, removed };
checks.expect_failure: an edit outside the recorded spans is REJECTED

checks.name: undoing by position rather than by string replace
checks.replace: for (const s of spans) undone = undone.split(s.to).join(s.from);
checks.expect_failure: the span round trip gives the original back byte for byte
checks._why: The bug the first version shipped with. ap-csa-lesson-4-1 links lesson 4-5 correctly in one place and with a newline in the handle in another, so a string replace turns the good link into a broken one and refuses a page it should repair.

checks.name: a href inside a <script> is not a link, and blanking it must keep the offsets
checks.expect_failure: a href inside a script is not classified at all
checks._why: This scanner shipped without it and reported 28 dead links that were working JavaScript: 14 practice-test pages build their prev and next buttons at runtime from a table of handles, so their source contains href="/pages/'+prev.handle+'". None of the 141 repairs landed inside a script, because a repair also has to resolve to a live page and a JS expression never does, but the reporting half was wrong and it put a page-content bug on the board that was really a bug here.
